name: ZeroB Ignite (UF+UV) HN2 Series
summary: ZeroB Ignite Hot & Normal UF+UV Online (HN2 Series) is an advanced online water purifier that delivers instant hot and normal purified water with 5-stage UF + UV purification .
intro: The ZeroB Ignite Hot & Normal UF+UV Online (HN2 Series) is a premium instant hot water purifier designed for homes and offices with a continuous water supply. Featuring advanced 5-stage UF + UV purification, it effectively removes bacteria and viruses while preserving essential minerals for safe, healthy drinking water. The intelligent hot water dispenser offers four temperature settings—ideal for milk, coffee, tea, and hot water—along with multiple dispensing volume options for added convenience. Its UV-protected pure water tank keeps stored water hygienic, while the sleek, compact design blends seamlessly into modern interiors.
features: Five dispensing volumes: 150 ml, 250 ml, 350 ml, 500 ml & 800 ml
UV-protected 1.4 L pure water storage tank
Suitable for feed water TDS up to 1500 ppm
Compact, elegant design for modern kitchens and offices
